en-US.title: Speed Unit Conversion and STW/SOG Vector Estimate
en-US.intro: Convert knots and km/h, and estimate speed over ground plus drift angle one-way from speed through water and a uniform current vector. Wind, waves and hull drift are excluded; SOG cannot be converted back to STW by scalar subtraction.
en-US.desc: Speed unit conversion + one-way STW/current vector estimate

zh-CN.title: 锚泊出链长度估算
zh-CN.intro: 输入水深、风速、流速、船舶吨位与底质，估算推荐出链长度（scope 3–7:1）与抓力等级
note: 按 Enter 快速估算，结果可一键复制
scope 基值 3，风速每档 +1（10/20/30kn），流速每档 +0.5
底质修正：泥/沙 +0，砾石 +0.5，海草/岩石 +1
抓力评估为定性参考，实际应结合锚型、链重与海况

en-US.title: Voyage Time & Speed Converter
en-US.intro: Choose the target, enter any two of speed, distance and time, and solve the third from distance = speed × time. Negative values, zero speed and division by zero are rejected; the estimate assumes uniform straight-line motion.

zh-CN.title: 船舶排水/载重吨计算
zh-CN.intro: 输入船舶垂线间长、型宽、首/中/尾吃水、方形系数与水密度计算排水量、TPC、MTC、纵倾与载重吨；Cb/Cw 越界会提示修正，不静默截断。
note: 按 Enter 快速计算，结果可一键复制
排水量 Δ = Cb·L·B·T_mean·ρ（吨）
TPC = Aw·ρ/100（t/cm），Aw=Cw·L·B
MTC = Δ·GML/(100·L)（t·m/cm），GML≈BM_L=Cw²·L²/(12·Cb·T_mean)
纵倾 = Ta−Tf（正值=尾倾）；DWT=Δ−空船重量

en-US.title: Vessel Displacement & Deadweight Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute displacement, TPC, MTC, trim and deadweight from LBP, beam, drafts, block coefficient and water density. Out-of-range Cb/Cw are rejected instead of silently clamped.

zh-CN.title: 潮汐（高/低潮）推算
zh-CN.intro: 输入参考站 4 次潮汐（时间+潮高+高/低）与副港差比推算副港潮汐；必须同时包含高潮与低潮，潮高比须大于 0，否则停止输出。
note: 按 Enter 快速推算，结果可一键复制
4 次潮汐按时间先后顺序填写（跨日可超过 24:00，如 25:30）
潮高比 > 1 表示副港潮差大于参考站，< 1 则相反
潮位曲线为余弦插值近似，实际潮汐受地形、气象影响

en-US.intro: Estimate secondary-port tides from four reference-port events and difference ratios. At least one high and one low water are required, and both height ratios must be greater than zero.
